name: Natori (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Natori city emblem in white: a disc crossed by two diagonal white bands.
history: Municipal flag of Natori, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1959.

features.role: Natori city emblem — a disc crossed by two diagonal white bands
